intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Douglas for 2026, and here is what he found: 5 family events, 1 of them free. The magic runs from November 28 (the Christmas Tree Lighting and G Avenue Light Parade) through December 27 (the last night of Douglas on Ice), with the Christmas Drive-In Movie (December 4), Christmas Kart Crew Photos with Santa (December 12) and Special Event with Santa at Douglas Public Library (December 16) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Douglas

  • 5 Christmas events for kids in Douglas
  • 1 free event, the tree lighting and G Avenue Light Parade; Douglas on Ice is admission by donation
  • Meet Santa: Christmas Kart Crew Photos at Raul Castro Park and the Santa event at Douglas Public Library
  • Parades and tree lightings: Super Douglas World Christmas Tree Lighting and G Avenue Light Parade (November 28)
  • Skating: Douglas on Ice, 12 evenings from December 4 to 27
  • Season: November 28 to December 27

Planning a bigger day out? Douglas families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Tucson, which covers Winterhaven Festival of Lights, the Downtown Parade of Lights and Festival, and Las Posadas Navidenas.
